# Kasanegi

> Kasanegi (かさねぎ) is a research and development studio in Osaka, Japan, built on one idea: use AI to find a new dimension in data that already exists. It is led by its founder, Tokitsugu Matsushita (松下宗嗣), a certified mineral appraiser and geology specialist, working with a team of AI agents centred on Claude Code.

The founder sets the questions and makes the final calls. Research design, checking against primary sources, data processing and verification, and software engineering are carried out by AI agents centred on Claude Code, across more than 6,600 Claude Code work sessions. Kasanegi is integrating all of its work into one foundation that uses AI to create new value from existing data.

## Work

- [Research: undiscovered meteorite craters in Japan](https://kasanegi.com/en/research/): machine learning on Japan-wide terrain data to find undiscovered meteorite craters. A ledger of 354 impact structures in 67 countries and regions, with 2,011 papers linked to 240 of them; 48 known craters processed from 1 m elevation data; the calculation behind Japan's nationwide red relief image map identified down to its formulas and constants and reproduced at Oikeyama to within one colour level on all 36 tiles. Oikeyama in Nagano Prefecture has been reported as a meteorite crater.
- [kasanegi language app](https://kasanegi.com/en/reader/): layers two language editions of the same manga page by page on the device. Pages are paired by artwork without relying on page order: 60 and 54 page pairs from two titles, with zero mix-ups. Images never leave the device. Runs on Android and PC, with a live browser demo at https://kasanegi.com/demo/. The PC beta has been well received, and more than twenty people have said they want to use it as a paid product.
- [Data APIs for AI agents](https://kasanegi.com/en/api/): a family of Japanese public-data APIs built and served since before the studio opened, through kasanegi.com, the RapidAPI marketplace and MCP. While the family is being integrated, the ten APIs of JP Local Pack are open free of charge as one example; further data APIs for company records, corporate disclosures and grants are opened as AI resources grow. MCP: https://mcp.kasanegi.com/mcp · OpenAPI: https://api.kasanegi.com/openapi.json · API llms.txt: https://api.kasanegi.com/llms.txt
- Video production system: AI handles everything from script to editing and publishing, fully automatically, across seven channels in different genres and languages. Facts are checked against their sources through a fixed procedure, and the founder sets the policy and the final standard. The newest channel reached one million total views within a month of launch, with 47,000 hours of total watch time. The system's revenue covers the studio's AI and development costs.

## Company

- Name: Kasanegi (かさねぎ), Osaka, Japan
- Founder: Tokitsugu Matsushita (松下宗嗣), certified mineral appraiser; author of a 2019 paper on dawsonite from the Shindachi Formation of the Izumi Group, published in Chigaku Kenkyu
- Contact: contact@kasanegi.com
- Site: https://kasanegi.com/ (Japanese) · https://kasanegi.com/en/ (English)
